Static bursts into clear voices, heat signatures move where nothing should exist, and sensors spike without warning. Dive into the most gripping moments of Expedition X as strange thermal and audio anomalies are exposed during the final evidence review. Relive the creepiest captures, closest calls, and baffling proof caught on camera.
Watch Expedition X Season 3 (Episodes 2, 3, 4 & 8) & Season 4 (Episodes 1, 2, 12 & 15) on Discovery Channel India.
